function.name: sol_h3
function.description: Generate a video with synchronized audio using Sol-H3. Use t2va for text-to-video or fl2va to animate the supplied first-frame image. Preserve the user's subjects, actions, style, and requested output settings. Supports one first frame; the FastH3 first-frame path is experimental. The worker fixes sampling to four steps, 24 fps, and its 768 short-edge/area-capped resolution policy.

task.description: Use the task assigned in the request: t2va for text only, fl2va when a first frame is supplied.

prompt.description: Describe subjects, actions over time, setting, camera, lighting, style, speech, sound, and music as useful. Preserve the original intent. Any clear descriptive format is supported; no special rewrite format is required.

conditions.description: Empty for t2va. For fl2va, include exactly the supplied input_image as an image keyframe at frame 0. Last frames and multiple keyframes are unsupported.

image_ref.description: Handle for the image shown in this request. The executor supplies its bytes.

duration_seconds.description: Defaults to 10 seconds. The worker rounds to 24 fps then up to 124 + 17*k frames, k=0..13. The rounded result must be 124..345 frames (5.167..14.375 seconds); 4 and 15 are invalid despite the outer numeric bounds. 5, 8, and 10 are accepted. For exact lengths send frames/24, e.g. 10.125 for 243 frames.

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to 16:9 for t2va and auto for fl2va. auto preserves the EXIF-upright first frame's shape (between 1:4 and 4:1). An explicit different shape stretches the image. Dimensions follow the worker's 1344x768 area cap and multiples of 32.

short_edge.description: The worker's only supported resolution setting; its area cap can reduce the actual short edge.

seed.description: Reproducible random seed. Omitted or null uses 42.
